description: This Kotlin source file defines the PaletteGenerator class responsible for creating visually distinct color palettes using HSL color model. It includes methods for generating colors, ensuring color distinctness, and handling palette size constraints.

classes.name: PaletteGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates visually distinct color palettes in HSL color space, configurable for color difference thresholds and palette size.

methods.name: generatePalette
methods.description: Generates a list of HSL colors forming a color palette with specified size, ensuring visual distinctness.

methods.name: randomDesignFriendly
methods.description: Creates a random HSL color within design-friendly constraints.

methods.name: tooSimilar
methods.description: Determines if two colors are too similar based on hue, saturation, and lightness thresholds.

methods.name: relaxedSimilar
methods.description: Checks if two colors are sufficiently similar when thresholds are relaxed.

methods.name: hueDistance
methods.description: Calculates the shortest distance between two hue values considering hue wrapping.
